name: opencode-sidebar
description: A focused chat sidebar for OpenCode agents in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: OpenCode can read files and run commands in the workspace, so the sidebar requires a trusted workspace.

opencodeSidebar.executablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `opencode` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` and common install locations.

opencodeSidebar.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of a running OpenCode server, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`. Leave empty to use the OpenCode background service discovered on this machine. Non-loopback URLs are refused unless `#opencodeSidebar.allowRemoteServer#` is enabled.

opencodeSidebar.allowRemoteServer.markdownDescription: Allow `#opencodeSidebar.serverUrl#` to point at a non-loopback host. Off by default.

opencodeSidebar.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Optional default model as `providerID/modelID` (for example `opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code`). Used when the workspace has no remembered selection.

opencodeSidebar.defaultAgent.markdownDescription: Optional default agent/mode id (for example `build` or `plan`).

opencodeSidebar.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start the OpenCode background service automatically when the sidebar opens and no service is running.

opencodeSidebar.showUsage.markdownDescription: Show context-window and cost figures reported by OpenCode.

opencodeSidebar.budget.default.markdownDescription: Task budget used when a workspace has no remembered choice. The budget is a local safety limit per task (one agent run); it only uses cost and step figures reported by OpenCode.

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

opencodeSidebar.budget.warnPercent.markdownDescription: Warn when a task reaches this percentage of its budget.

opencodeSidebar.budget.contextWarnPercen.markdownDescription: Warn when the context window is this full (warning only, never stops the agent). `0` disables the warning.

opencodeChat.notifications.taskComplete.markdownDescription: Show a notification when an OpenCode task completes. Not shown while you are watching the chat (view visible and VS Code focused).

opencodeChat.notifications.needsInput.markdownDescription: Show a notification when OpenCode needs your input (a question or a permission request).

opencodeChat.notifications.taskFailed.markdownDescription: Show a notification when an OpenCode task fails.

opencodeChat.notifications.budgetStopped.markdownDescription: Show a notification when Budget Guard stops a task.

scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test/acceptance/runAcceptance.js
scripts.test:webview: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec "out-test/test/webview/*.test.js"
